1: # frozen_string_literal: true
2: 
3: require_relative '../path_tracker/pages'
4: require_relative './notifier'
5: require 'colorize'
6: module FileReader
7:   class Parser
8:     prepend Notifier
9: 
10:     def initialize(file:, pages: PathTracker::Pages.new)
11:       @file = file
12:       @pages = pages
13:     end
14: 
15:     def call
16:       raise ArgumentError, 'No file to parse.'.red if file.nil?
17: 
18:       parse_file_to_pages
19:     end
20: 
21:     private
22: 
23:       attr_reader :file, :pages
24: 
25:       def parse_file_to_pages
26:         file.each_line do |line|
27:           next if line.chomp.empty?
28: 
29:           path = get_path(line)
30:           ip_address = get_ip_address(line)
31:           next if path.nil? || ip_address.nil?
32: 
33:           page = pages.find_page_by_path(path) || pages.add_page(path)
34:           page.add_visit(ip_address)
35:         end
36:         pages
37:       end
38: 
39:       def get_path(line)
40:         line[%r{^(?:/[^/\s]+)+}]
41:       end
42: 
43:       def get_ip_address(line)
44:         line[/(?:[0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/]
45:       end
46:   end
47: end

12:       @visits_count = 0

18:       @visits_by_ip[ip_address] += 1
19:       @visits_count += 1

28:     end

5: module Validators
6:   class FileValidator
7:     def self.call(args)
8:       validate_arguments!(args)
9:       validate_file!(args)
10:     end
11: 
12:     def self.validate_arguments!(args)
13:       raise Errors::FileParsing::NoArgumentError            if args.empty?
14:       raise Errors::FileParsing::NotSupportedArgumentError  if args.count > 1
15:     end
16: 
17:     def self.validate_file!(args)
18:       raise Errors::FileParsing::FileNotFoundError               unless File.file?(args[0])
19:       raise Errors::FileParsing::NotSupportedFileExtensionError  unless File.extname(args[0]) == '.log'
20:       raise Errors::FileParsing::EmptyFileError                  if File.zero?(args[0])
21:     end
22:   end
23: end

3: require 'open3'
4: require 'tempfile'
5: require 'rbconfig'
6: 
7: RSpec.describe 'log parser CLI' do
8:   def run_parser(*arguments)
9:     Open3.capture3(RbConfig.ruby, File.expand_path('../../../bin/log_parser.rb', __dir__), *arguments)
10:   end
11: 
12:   it 'counts repeated visitors independently for each page' do
13:     Tempfile.create(['visits', '.log']) do |file|
14:       file.write("/home 127.0.0.1\n/home 127.0.0.1\n/home 127.0.0.2\n/about 127.0.0.1\n")
15:       file.flush
16:       stdout, stderr, status = run_parser(file.path)
17:       expect(status).to be_success
18:       expect(stderr).to eq('')
19:       expect(stdout).to match(%r{/home\s+=> unique 2 visits})
20:       expect(stdout).to match(%r{/home\s+=> 3 visits})
21:       expect(stdout).to match(%r{/about\s+=> unique 1 visits})
22:     end
23:   end
24: 
25:   it 'shows the missing-argument message without a Ruby traceback' do
26:     stdout, stderr, status = run_parser
27:     expect(status).not_to be_success
28:     expect(stdout).to include('No log file provided.')
29:     expect(stderr).to eq('')
30:   end
31: 
32:   it 'shows the missing-file message without a Ruby traceback' do
33:     stdout, stderr, status = run_parser('/definitely-missing/slop-guard.log')
34:     expect(status).not_to be_success
35:     expect(stdout).to include('File not found.')
36:     expect(stderr).to eq('')
37:   end
38:   it 'runs the bundled benchmark against the supplied log fixture' do
39:     stdout, stderr, status = Open3.capture3(RbConfig.ruby, File.expand_path('../../../bin/benchmark.rb', __dir__), 'spec/fixtures/webserver.log')
40:     expect(status).to be_success
41:     expect(stderr).to eq('')
42:     expect(stdout).to include('Number of lines parsed:')
43:   end
44: 
45: end
